_comment: Golden set for the offline eval harness (ROADMAP 0.4.0). PENDING OWNER APPROVAL.
Built from the ACTUAL corpus, without inventing legal content: each question is a
natural-language topic query and its ground_truth_sources are the real corpus
file(s) whose subject matter answers it (a factual law->topic mapping). Filenames
are exactly the sources present in db/. The first 15 questions are the known-good
acceptance_m1.py queries; the rest extend coverage to the remaining laws.
No expected free-text answer is authored here (that would risk inventing legal
specifics); retrieval metrics score whether the right SOURCE is retrieved. An
LLM-judged faithfulness layer (Ragas/DeepEval, local judge) is added separately.
